run_mfg_fictitious_play: run fictitious play on an MFG game with configurable iterations, learning rate, and logging
create_mfg_game: create an MFG game with a specified name and optional setting from the factory
run_fictitious_play_iteration: run fictitious play iterations to compute policies and track exploitability over time
compute_nash_conv: compute Nash convolution (exploitability) of a fictitious play policy against the game
log_mfg_distribution: log the parametric distribution of an MFG solution to a pickle file at each iteration
